name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana (Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation)
benefit: - **Loan Assistance:** An amount of ₹20,000/- at 5% interest rate, with a repayment period of 5 years.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a woman sweeper or a dependent of a woman sweeper. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
